correctness.rationale: Fixing a cycle vertex determines all vertices of its functional-digraph component. No self-loop is permitted, so each component has at least two coordinates. An odd number of coordinates forces a size-three-or-larger component: count its root first, then roots of the remaining components against distinct unused symbols, obtaining n(n-3)(n-5)...2. For even lengths the analogous bound is n(n-2)...2. The stated explicit construction has an f-permutation triple prefix and h-involution repairable pair suffix; its n times 2^(m-1)(m-1)! distinct words meet the odd bound for all m>=1, with fixed recovery positions. verify.py independently tests all described codewords for n=2..11, and verify_n5.py rules out 11 with an exhaustive 1024-pattern compatibility-census. Finite tests supplement but do not replace the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: The Jan 2016 full manuscript of Raviv--Yaakobi--Medard introduces this exact nonadaptive notion (see its Section 3.1), proves an unrefined n!! upper bound, and attains that bound by pair blocks for even n only (Section 4.2, requiring 2|n). For odd n it states a pair-block (n-1)!! lower construction (later odd comparison in Section 4.4). For odd n>=5 the precise proven optimum n(n-3)!! is strictly between the two earlier numbers, so the inspected claims do not imply the new equality. A later 32-page journal version was inaccessible in full; it may contain subsequent improvements. This remains a genuine bibliographic risk, and semantic-search absence is not treated as proof of universal novelty.
residual_risks: The expanded 2018 journal full text was inaccessible despite lawful access attempts and may contain the odd bound or a stronger result not present in the inspected early full manuscript.
Unindexed independent work or a database not returned by semantic/text searches could give equivalent odd extrema.

value.rationale: Determines the entire odd-length cardinality sequence for a natural established one-erasure single-query recovery system, closing a real parameter gap rather than changing notation or one entry of a table. The construction achieves the refined resource limit at every odd length and quantifies the parity loss from the unrefined upper bound; at length five it changes the gap 8..15 into the exact value 10. The result is restricted to the original fixed-observer model.
